title: Q2 Results 15th Oct Live: Tata Communications' Q2 results mixed, Nestle Q2 PAT up 36% y-o-y, Polycab, KVB, UCO Bank PAT rise, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Jio Financial, IRFC, HDFC AMC, HDFC Life, IIFL, Pers
text:
Two investors are working together with analyzing the stock data graphs in the paper and viewing the data on the laptop screen. istock photo for BL | Photo Credit: wutwhanfoto

Q2 Results Today, 15th October 2026 Live Updates: Find all the latest Q2 results 2026 updates of 360 ONE WAM, Tata Communications, Tech Mahindra, Tips Music, Wipro, HDFC Life, Indian Bank, IRFC, HDFC AMC,Persistent Systems and Neslte.

LOSERS: MRPL, HDB Financial, CEAT, Canara Bank

Follow our stock market live here | Stay tuned to businessline for more

Karur Vysya Bank: Logs 37.2% y-o-y increase in net profit to ₹787.69 crore

Nestle India: Q2 PAT rises 36% to ₹1026.7 crore

Polycab India: Standalone PAT rises 44% y-o-y to ₹965.2 cr

Tata Communications: Con. PAT rises to ₹335.61 cr in Q2

DBCORP: Q2 CONS NET PROFIT 686M RUPEES VS 935M (YOY); EST 1B DBCORP: Q2 EBITDA 910M RUPEES VS 1.38B (YOY); Q2 EBITDA MARGIN 15.66% VS 22.48% (YOY) DBCORP: Q2 REVENUE 5.8B RUPEES VS 6.14B (YOY)

Orient Electric reported net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 27.06 crore, compared to Rs 12.06 crore in September 2025 quarter.

Shares surged over 4% to Rs 180.68 on the NSE.

Karur Vysya Bank reported a 37.2% y-o-y increase in net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 787.69 crore, compared to Rs 573.96 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

Tata Communications reported standalone PAT of Rs 125.86 crore in Q2FY27, down 40% from Rs 210.94 crore in Q2FY26.

On a consolidated basis, it grew 83% to Rs 335.61 crore during the quarter under review compared to Rs 183.21 crore in Q2FY26.

The board approved the transfer of the entire shareholding held by the Company in Kaleyra, Inc., to Tata Communications (Netherlands) B.V. (‘TCNL’), a wholly- owned subsidiary of the Company

Shares were up 3.5% to Rs 1717.70 on the NSE.

Tips Music reported net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 65.74 crore compared to Rs 53.19 crore in September 2025 quarter.

Declared the first interim dividend for the financial year 2026-2027 of Rs. 6.50/- per equity share (i.e. 650%) on the fully paid-up equity shares of the face value of Re. 1/- per share.

Shares traded at Rs 691.25 on the NSE, down 4%

South Indian Bank reported standalone PAT of Rs 426.13 crore in Q2FY27, up 21% from Rs 351.37 crore in Q2FY25.

Shares traded 2% lower at Rs 48.58 on the NSE.

UCO Bank reported net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 785.64 crore, up 20% y-o-y from Rs 619.76 crore in the quarter ended Sep. 2025.

The EPC business demonstrated strong momentum, delivering 53% year-on-year revenue growthduring the quarter. Segment profitability remained healthy, with EBIT margins of 7.2%. Backed by ahealthy order book, the business is well-positioned to sustain growth.

The FMEG segment delivered another breakthrough quarter, with revenues increasing more thandoubling year-on-year (+124%) on the back of strong demand across all key product categories. Solarcontinued to lead the growth story, reporting multifold expansion and retaining its position as thelargest contributor to segment revenues. The quarter also marked a defining moment in thebusiness’s profitability journey, as EBIT margins surpassed the double digit threshold for the first timeever, reaching an all-time high of 10.1%. This achievement underscores the effectiveness of our scaledriven growth strategy, enhanced portfolio mix, and sustained focus on operational excellence,positioning the segment for continued value creation.

EBITDA grew by a strong 39% YoY and 25% QoQ, driven by sequential margin expansion across segments.

Consolidated EBITDA margins improved by ~53 bps sequentially to 14.4%.

The Maggi maker reported consolidated sales of ₹6,782.2 crore, driven by robust double-digit volume growth across product categories and higher brand investments.

Inder T. Jaisinghani, Chairman and Managing Director of Polycab India Limited, highlighted record Q2 and H1 FY27 performance, driven by strong Wires & Cables growth, improving FMEG business, healthy domestic demand, and sustained international momentum. He reaffirmed the company’s focus on accelerating growth, premiumization, deeper market penetration, and long-term shareholder value through Project Spring.

Indian Bank posted standalone PAT of Rs 3,462.24 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 3,018.22 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares traded at Rs 830.45 on the NSE, down 2%.

Polycab India reported standalone PAT of Rs 965.2 crore in Q2FY27, up nearly 44% from Rs 671 crore in Q2FY26.

Coffee and wheat are expected to remain range-bound, while sugar and edible oils have stabilized at elevated levels. Cocoa remains volatile due to weather-driven crop concerns in key origins. Milk prices have strengthened seasonally but should ease as flush supplies arrive.

“Rising inflation, particularly food inflation, is a reality. We remain focused on navigating these external challenges through continuous innovation and renovation, sustained investments behind our brands, and an intensified focus on productivity and operational efficiencies to mitigate commodity cost pressures,” Manish Tiwary, Chairman and MD, Nestle India

“I am pleased to share that the quarter saw a continuation of strong and broad-based growth across all product groups, with total sales reaching INR 6,782.2 crore, with a growth of 20.5%, that was driven by robust, double-digit volume growth. We continued to focus on efficiencies across our operations while significantly increasing investments behind our brands, with advertising and marketing spends up by 46%. EBITDA margin remained healthy at 23.8%. Profit After Tax for the quarter stood at INR 1,026.8 crore, up 36.3% over the corresponding quarter.”

Manish Tiwary, CMD, Nestle India Meenakshi Verma Ambwani 10062

- Manish Tiwary, Chairman and Managing Director, Nestlé India

Fedbank Financial Services posted net profit of Rs 130.75 crore in September 2026 quarter compared to Rs 80.15 crore in September 2025 quarter
